limitations: Synthetic trace only; no CARLA original frame map or camera pixels
necessity and immediacy are unresolved legal judgments
fixture source refs are deliberately not original Native hashes

negative_rejections.ambiguous_path: passing path side must be unambiguous
negative_rejections.moving_vehicle: vehicle not stationary during door-open interval
negative_rejections.no_transfer: sourced passenger or cargo transfer events required
negative_rejections.nonmonotone_frame: contiguous original Native frame/time join required
negative_rejections.truncated_door: door interval truncated at capture end
negative_rejections.unsourced_door: sourced door-open state required for every frame
negative_rejections.unsourced_transfer: sourced passenger or cargo event required
negative_rejections.wrong_operator: selected driver must operate the observed door
negative_rejections.wrong_side: observed door is not on passing-traffic side
